name: ccfa-skills
description: A coordinated skill family for CCF research papers.

interface.shortDescription: Research skills from idea to submission.
interface.longDescription: Nineteen focused skills help researchers develop ideas, read and translate papers, gather evidence, design experiments, write and review manuscripts, create scientific figures, and prepare submissions while preserving a coherent research story.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose the CCFA skill that best matches the research task, preserve evidence and terminology, and use Humanization when refining publication prose.
